purpose: Feasibility panel for design review; no power or prevalence claim
selection_constraints: Freeze dataset/series/window IDs, forecast origin, source hash, context hash and scale before inference
Original series must be distinct across all six cells; retain source-series clusters
Context length512 and horizon32; reject invalid IQR without a fallback
Use context-only selection; no future values, forecast error or FPA scores
Fix deterministic representative sampling and diversity descriptors/seed before selecting IDs; record eligible pool and exclusions
No stratified panel prevalence or confirmatory claim; two-series quotas reflect feasibility, not statistical power
Keep already studied engineering context labeled separately; it is not a held-out scientific replicate

fixed_outcomes: terminal abs deviation from frozen greedy / context IQR
last8 mean abs deviation from frozen greedy / context IQR

cost_caveats: One selected flat-greedy context, CPU float32/eager, one thread; no cross-domain worst-case guarantee
2x factor is planning headroom, not a probabilistic upper bound
Raw payload excludes metadata, duplicated baseline capture and filesystem overhead; compression unguaranteed
All-step replay cost from only eight paths, warm state; linear extrapolation not measured campaign throughput
Cap8 changes branching and residual fragmentation; scaling is approximate
Current 30-minute model authorization does not cover this suggested panel
Current measured peak747.04MiB does not bound retained prefix caches for a panel
before_any_campaign: Freeze grid IDs and scientific selection rules after review
Implement bounded streaming/replay batches and cache eviction; test memory/disk limits with complete manifests
Resolve estimator covariance/variance at P9/P10/P11; predeclare uncertainty interpretation
Obtain separate explicit runtime, storage, hardware and inference authorization
